arguments.query:
import cpp

from FunctionCall call, Expr sizeArg
where call.getTarget().getName() = "memcpy" and
  sizeArg = call.getArgument(2) and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c" and
  exists(IntegralType it | it = sizeArg.getType() and it.isSigned())
select call, "memcpy called with signed size argument: " + sizeArg.toString()

arguments.command: cd /src/mruby && grep -n "static const char \*get_num" -n mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c && nl -ba mrbgems/mruby-sprintf/src/sprintf.c | sed -n '260,360p'
